description.text: Training Center has teaching faculty with profound knowledge and rich experiences in the training of the Chinese Language.It offers effective training programs all the year round for those who wish to improve their Chinese Language proficiency. Students can choose classes at different levels according to their own levels. Class Level Class Name Schedule Objective Intermediate Chinese I Intermediate Comprehensive Chinese The class begins in September every year. For students who already have more than 2000 words or have learned Chinese for more than 800 class hours, they can learn more than 3500 words, read Chinese newspaper, write essay more than 300 words and pass HSK Elementary-Intermediate by the end of the semester. Writing Intermediate Listening and Speaking Newspaper and Magazine Reading Intermediate Chinese II Intermediate Comprehensive Chinese The class begins in Feburary or March every year. For students who already have more than 3500 words or have learned Chinese for more than 1200 class hours, they can learn more than 5000 words, make more complete conversation in social and economic phenomena, read Chinese newspaper more quickly, write essay more than 400 words and pass HSK Elementary-Intermediate by the end of the semester. Writing Intermediate Listening and Speaking Newspaper and Magazine Reading

duration.text: The Intermediate Chinese Language and Culture Program at Wuhan University of Technology is a 20 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1111 USD/In total ￥ 8000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.Health Certificate Photocopy of physical examination record.

requirements.text: Non-Chinese, who haven’t broken laws, are ready to understand China and Chinese culture, with high school diploma and more than 16 years old.
